background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open
an asset browser is open over the workspace

scenario_steps.name: the browser has a title, close control and search field
its upper region contains document assets
its lower region contains a library selector, category tree and asset view
each region has a display-options control
the model workspace remains visible behind the browser

scenarios.name: Search document and library assets independently

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open
an asset browser is open over the workspace

scenario_steps.name: the current document has no asset matching a known library search term
the active library has matching assets
I enter the search term in the browser search field
the document region reports that the term was not found in the document
the library region shows matching assets
the library tree shows results grouped by library and category

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open
an asset browser is open over the workspace

scenario_steps.name: an asset search is active
I clear the search field
the document assets return
the lower region returns to library browsing

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open
an asset browser is open over the workspace

scenario_steps.name: I open the document region display menu
it offers Show All, Show Used and Show Unused
it offers Thumbnail View, List View and Text View
it offers sort and thumbnail-size choices

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a part document open
an asset browser is open over the workspace

scenario_steps.name: I close the asset browser
its window closes
the part document and modeling workspace remain open
